headline: Profit surges year-over-year while cash position weakens
summary_short: Revenue was $1,986M (+18.9% y/y), with net income of $397M (+97.5% y/y) and diluted EPS of $1.56 (+97.5% y/y); operating cash flow swung to -$242M from +$17M a year ago, while total cash fell 20.1% q/q to $2,288M.
summary_long: Q2 FY2026 revenue was $1,986M, up 18.9% y/y but down 6.3% q/q. Gross profit rose 23.0% y/y to $1,712M and operating income rose 89.3% y/y to $513M. Net income reached $397M (+97.5% y/y) with diluted EPS of $1.56 (+97.5% y/y). Operating cash flow was -$242M, versus +$17M a year earlier. Total cash fell 20.1% q/q to $2,288M from $2,864M. Shareholders' equity was $7,079M, up from $6,082M a year ago.
